method.gate: Builds, type/schema consumers, compiler/interpreter tests, Dum package contracts, consumer workflows, exported interfaces, published-package failure paths and shared error identity, canonical differential results and exact issues, adversarial cases, and runtime/declaration isolation

Mutable artifact stress is stricter than the readonly TypeScript artifact contract
